items.title: Send Grace the signed budget page
items.quote: Please send me the signed budget page by the end of the day.
items.date_text: by the end of the day
items.note: End of the day = the written-on day, Tue Oct 20; no clock time stated. 0.90.

items.title: Grace to send the narrative draft
items.quote: I'll have the narrative draft to you Thursday at the latest.
items.note: 'at the latest' is masked; Thu Oct 22. 0.95.

items.title: Meet Grace to walk through the numbers
items.quote: Can we meet tomorrow morning at 8 to walk through the numbers?
items.note: 'morning' states AM: 8:00 AM CDT = 13:00Z, explicit, no AM/PM line. 0.90.

items.title: Ask Dev for the updated headcount figures
items.quote: Also, could you ask Dev for the updated headcount figures by Friday?
items.note: 0.90. Dev is who the user must ask; the request comes from Grace.
